import codecs
for encoding in ('unicode_escape', 'raw_unicode_escape'):
    decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)('escape_state_user')
    failure = ValueError('retained callback')
    fail = True
    class Position:
        def __init__(self, error):
            self.error = error
        def __index__(self):
            assert input() == 'ready'
            self.error.object = b'RZ'
            decoder.setstate((b'index mutation', 0))
            return -1
    def recover(error):
        if fail:
            decoder.setstate((b'\\u20', 0))
            assert input() == 'ready'
            raise failure
        return ('!', Position(error))
    codecs.register_error('escape_state_user', recover)
    assert decoder.decode(b'\\u12') == ''
    saved = decoder.getstate()
    try:
        decoder.decode(b'Q', True)
    except ValueError as caught:
        assert caught is failure
        assert caught.args == ('retained callback',)
    else:
        assert False
    assert saved == (b'\\u12', 0)
    assert decoder.getstate() == (b'\\u20', 0)
    assert decoder.decode(b'ac', True) == '\u20ac'
    decoder.reset()
    fail = False
    assert decoder.decode(b'\\u12') == ''
    assert decoder.decode(b'Q', True) == '!Z'
    assert decoder.getstate() == (b'', 0)
print('escape recovery verified')
